title: Leveraging Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Crime Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.29667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial crime detection requires identifying illicit activity within large transaction networks, where suspicious behaviour is rare and unfolds over time. Existing graph-based methods capture relationships among accounts but typically underuse the temporal behaviour encoded in account transaction histories. We introduce Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE), a framework that addresses this gap by summarising each account's transaction history with a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM), and enriching each transaction's representation with the relevant temporal context from these summaries. These enriched representations can be scored directly for edge classification, or fed into a graph neural network (GNN) as edge features to capture broader structural information. Across six AMLWorld datasets, TCEE improves PR-AUC over the strongest evaluated baseline on five by a relative 10.8% on average, while training 6.0x faster end-to-e

translated_title: 利用时间序列基础模型进行金融犯罪检测
translated_abstract: 金融犯罪检测需要在大规模交易网络中识别非法活动，其中可疑行为稀少且随时间逐步演变。现有的基于图的方法能够捕捉账户之间的关系，但通常未能充分利用账户交易历史中编码的时间行为信息。我们提出了时间上下文边增强框架，通过使用冻结的时间序列基础模型对每个账户的交易历史进行总结，并利用这些摘要中的相关时间上下文来丰富每笔交易的表示。这些增强的表示可以直接用于边分类评分，也可以作为边特征输入图神经网络（GNN），以捕捉更广泛的结构信息。在六个AMLWorld数据集上，TCEE在其中五个数据集上将PR-AUC相比最强的评估基线平均相对提升10.8%，同时端到端训练速度提升6.0倍。
tldr: 该论文提出TCEE框架，利用冻结的时间序列基础模型总结账户交易历史的时间上下文来增强交易边的表示，在六个AMLWorld数据集上将PR-AUC相比最强基线平均相对提升10.8%，同时训练速度提升6倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TCEE, a framework that enriches transaction edge representations with temporal context from frozen time-series foundation models, improving PR-AUC over the strongest baseline by 10.8% on average across six AMLWorld datasets while training 6.0x faster end-to-end.
